newsitem.title: USA: Computer Network says sees Q2 loss.
newsitem.headline: Computer Network says sees Q2 loss.

text.p: Computer Network Technology Corp said it expects revenues and earnings for the second quarter ended June 30 to be below analysts' estimates because of delays in signed contracts for OEM business and softness in international and new product sales.
Consensus estimates for the company's second quarter are $.05 per share, according to First Call and Zacks Investment Research, the company said.
Computer Network said it expects to report a loss for the quarter on revenues of about $19.5 million to $21.5 million.
The company also said its full year results will be lower than analysts' estimates.
For the second quarter of 1996, the company reported earnings of $.05 per share on revenues of $25.5 million.
The company said it will report its second quarter results on July 17.
